notes.title: Trees Graphics Overhaul Released
notes.notes:
We promised an update a few weeks ago, and it's finally here.  The trees have completely been redone.  Pure 3D trees are problematic on the Rift due to the 90FPS requirement.  We simply couldn't crank out enough trees and maintain decent frame rate in VR.  We've spent the past few months creating new tree algorithms and models to give a photorealistic feel, while maintaining performance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40620713/2b386546d092f101abfa0383130f7578cb26ecf6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Tree and Graphics Updates - August 5th, 2021
notes.notes:
We've implemented a new tree system that allows us to pump out 2x the trees.

We've also implemented graphics options that lets you assign your tree density levels, draw distance, and resolution.

More updates to come, this is just the beginning!
